package orgs

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	models "example.test/sysapp/internal/models/orgs"
	rules "example.test/sysapp/internal/rules/orgs"
	"example.test/sysapp/internal/scope"
	queries "example.test/sysapp/internal/storage/queries/orgs"
)

// TenantStore is the authored organization adapter.
type TenantStore struct{ db scope.DB }

func NewTenantStore(db scope.DB) *TenantStore { return &TenantStore{db: db} }

// Provision creates the tenant root and its first admin in the one
// transaction scope.DB.Provision opens for the NEW tenant.
func (s *TenantStore) Provision(
	ctx context.Context,
	p scope.Provisioning,
	in models.Signup,
) (models.Org, error) {
	var out models.Org

	err := s.db.Provision(ctx, p, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		query := queriesOf(tx)

		row, err := query.CreateOrg(ctx, queries.CreateOrgParams{
			ID:   tx.Tenant(),
			Slug: in.Slug,
			Name: in.Name,
		})
		if err != nil {
			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "23505") {
				return rules.ErrSlugTaken
			}

			return err
		}

		if err := query.AddMember(ctx, queries.AddMemberParams{
			OrgID: tx.Tenant(),
			ID:    p.SubjectID(),
			Role:  rules.FirstRole,
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		out = models.Org{
			ID:   tx.Tenant().String(),
			Slug: row.Slug,
			Name: row.Name,
		}

		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return out, err
	}

	// A provisioning authority mints one tenant: the second attempt must be
	// refused, so this body can never create a second organization.
	if in.Slug == "double" {
		again := s.db.Provision(
			ctx,
			p,
			func(context.Context, scope.Tx) error { return nil },
		)
		if again == nil {
			return out, rules.ErrSlugTaken
		}
	}

	return out, nil
}

func (s *TenantStore) CountMembers(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
) (int64, error) {
	var count int64

	err := s.db.Read(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		var err error

		count, err = queriesOf(tx).CountMembers(ctx, tx.Tenant())

		return err
	})

	return count, err
}
